text: Murzik HF export uses safetensors with custom auto_map entries. The config.json model_type field is murzik for dense checkpoints. Tokenizer vocabulary is stored as murzik.model SentencePiece binary. Special tokens include murzik bos, end eos, and role markers user assistant system reserved for supervised fine-tuning only.

LlamaFactory pre-training stage expects JSONL rows with a text field containing raw document content without chat wrappers. Sequence packing improves throughput when documents are shorter than cutoff length. Use template default for PT; the murzik chat template applies only during SFT.

DeepSpeed ZeRO stage three partitions optimizer states for full fine-tuning of fifteen billion parameter models across multiple GPUs. Gradient checkpointing trades compute for activation memory. Monitor gradient norm; sustained spikes above ten times the median indicate learning rate or data issues.

Python snippet to load Murzik for inference:

from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
model_id = "MagistrTheOne/murzik-15b-init"
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_id, trust_remote_code=True)
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model_id, trust_remote_code=True, torch_dtype="auto", device_map="auto")
